title: Appeals on Re-employment Disputes and Instances where Conciliation Failed and where Errant Employer is a Public Sector Employer
what_it_is: Appeals on Re-employment Disputes and Instances where Conciliation Failed and where Errant Employer is a Public Sector Employer

sections.label: Re-employment dispute outcomes
sections.summary: About 90% of disputes were resolved through mediation, with about 10 cases a year decided by the Minister or ECT.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: About 90% of the disputes were amicably resolved through the mediation process including instances where the employee subsequently withdrew his or her appeal.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: On average, about 10 cases a year are decided by the Minister or the ECT.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Of these, 60%, or about six cases, were dismissed due to lack of merit, for example, the employee failed to meet the re-employment eligibility criteria due to unsatisfactory work performance or the employer was able to prove that there were no suitable vacancies for re-employment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The other 40%, or about four cases a year, were found to be substantiated and resulted in compensation to the employee from the employer.

sections.label: Employment Assistant Payment amount
sections.summary: The Employment Assistant Payment amount has been determined and a tripartite consensus is in the guidelines.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In fact, for this Employment Assistant Payment (EAP), the amount has been something that has been determined and a tripartite consensus is in the guidelines.

sections.label: TAFEP guidelines and legislation
sections.summary: Information is on the website, and the Tripartite Committee is still looking at translating TAFEP guidelines into legislation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: If the Member is keen, she can look up the website where all the information is available.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And as for updates, I think the Tripartite Committee is still looking at how we can translate the Tripartite Guidelines on Fair Employment Practices (TAFEP) into legislation.

sections.label: Compensation quantum adjudication
sections.summary: The Minister for Manpower will objectively look at the facts of each case when adjudicating compensation quantums.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: So, is he saying that the same formula applies to both scenarios?

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I think in adjudicating some of the compensation quantums, the Minister for Manpower will objectively look at the facts of the case because each case is different.

sections.label: Employee health and compensation
sections.summary: The employee's health status must be looked into, so compensation calculation is not one-size-fits-all.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The health status of the employee also has to be looked into, because certain jobs will require a certain degree of medical fitness to continue.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Therefore, it is not a one-size-fits-all type of calculation on the compensation amount.
